segments.title: Pepito's Sunday Sign-On
segments.notes: Executive Producer Pepito opens the broadcast with a live sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Sunday Pre-Show and Dread Mode Selection
segments.notes: Case Blackwell counts down, confirms No Breaks November, notes a scheduled collaborator's absence, and chooses Slay the Spire 2's new Dread Mode over weekend news or Rennerton.

segments.title: Shroyuken Power Glove Clip
segments.notes: Case gives a brief viral-clip review of a street-fight power glove video.

segments.title: Actual Room and Looks Maxing
segments.notes: Case broadcasts from his real room, checks his looks maxing, and debates emo instrumentals with Kendelle and chat.

segments.title: Brand Feeds and Mustard Cake Hacks
segments.notes: Case and Kendelle react to Dr. Seuss, Nutterbutters, Lionsgate, and Little Debbie social content.

segments.title: Dread Mode Slay the Spire 2: Act I Tutorial
segments.notes: Case teaches chat the new Fool deck, Dread Mode boss buffs, and early deck-building while climbing Act I.

segments.title: Kickstarter Milestone
segments.notes: Case thanks a viewer gift and reports the Kickstarter has passed 200 followers.

segments.title: Dread Mode Act I Boss
segments.notes: Case finishes Act I, survives elites, and defeats the first boss.

segments.title: Dread Mode Act II: Kaiser Crab
segments.notes: Case enters Act II, gains Ascender's Veins, and battles Kaiser Crab and elite enemies.

segments.title: Dread Mode Act III: Queen and Eon Glass
segments.notes: Case reaches the final act, manages wither cards, and clears the act's bosses.

segments.title: Final Boss and Dread Mode Defeat
segments.notes: Case faces the hardest boss and dies after a close final sequence.

segments.title: Sign-Off and Raid Wrap-Up
segments.notes: Case closes the stream, promises regular news tomorrow, and raids another channel.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchor Case Blackwell trades the weekend news desk for a marathon Dread Mode run in Slay the Spire 2.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive Producer Pepito opens the broadcast with the official sign-on and countdown.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: In-studio contributor Kendelle appears during the Sunday stream and reacts to Case's card-game marathon.

storylines.beat: [09:01] Case confirms the Sunday broadcast remains part of No Breaks November despite a scheduled collaborator's absence.

lore_notes.fact: The Sunday edition of No Breaks November is logged as a non-news Dread Mode stream after Case Blackwell forgoes the usual weekend desk.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened Sunday with Executive Producer Pepito's sign-on, then Case Blackwell kept No Breaks November alive by setting aside the usual weekend desk after a scheduled collaborator fell through. Blackwell spent the broadcast teaching chat the new Dread Mode in Slay the Spire 2, interrupted by Kickstarter housekeeping and a detour through brand social feeds. The run ended in defeat at the final boss, followed by a sign-off and raid to another channel.
